correctness.rationale: The reset-age integral is exact. Brownian Wick identities and Ito isometry yield M2, M4 and mixed environment moment; Markov generator gives conditional future squared position and cross-moment closure. For fixed ratio c>1 these imply \(2/(17c)\) with asymptotic squared-position variance coefficient \(272\Lambda^4/r^2\). Brownian scaling, local environment replacement mean-square error \(O(T^{-1})\), and independent Poisson windows imply a joint Brownian-normal-exponential weak limit. Gaussian-exponential mixing gives an independent normal times Laplace, density logarithmic singularity and an explicit saddlepoint stretched-exponential tail. 219 deterministic standard-library checker assertions passed; finite tests are not infinity proofs. Risk: assumption of positive fixed r and bounded finite set of ratios is essential.

value.rationale: An explicitly motivated physical gap asks whether Poisson resetting a tracer but not its warming stochastic medium suffices for a steady state. It does not: there is a new \(\sqrt t\) normal-times-Laplace weak limit, stretched tails, and persistent macroscopic squared memory despite vanishing linear correlation. The quantitative coefficient is universal in the rate and stochastic diffusivity scale and discriminates environmental rejuvenation experimentally. This is a structural nonrenewal reset consequence, not a routine parameter substitution.
